title: Seafloor water around Antarctica from the OCEAN ICE Southern Ocean Climatology (annual mean; every profile 1972-2023, and the profiles since 2000)
product_version: The OCEAN ICE Southern Ocean Climatology, version 2 (annual mean, created 16 October 2025)
reference: Zhou, S., Dutrieux, P. and Giulivi, C. (2024). The OCEAN ICE Southern Ocean Climatology. SEANOE. https://doi.org/10.17882/103946

source_dataset.title: The OCEAN ICE Southern Ocean Climatology
source_dataset.citation: Zhou, S., Dutrieux, P. and Giulivi, C. (2024). The OCEAN ICE Southern Ocean Climatology. SEANOE. https://doi.org/10.17882/103946
source_dataset.article: Zhou, S., Dutrieux, P., Giulivi, C., Meijers, A., Lee, W. S., Kim, T.-W., Hattermann, T. and Janout, M. (2026). The OCEAN ICE hydrography profiles compilation and climatology. Earth System Science Data Discussions. https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-2025-727
source_dataset.profiles: Zhou, S., Dutrieux, P., Giulivi, C., Lee, W. S., Kim, T.-W., Hattermann, T. and Janout, M. (2026). Southern Ocean (90S-45S) conservative temperature and absolute salinity profiles compilation (OCEAN ICE D1.1). SEANOE. https://doi.org/10.17882/99787

source_grid.description: OCEAN ICE climatology: 0.2 deg longitude x 0.1 deg latitude, 180 W-180 E, 90 S-45 S, 601 levels at 10 dbar from 5 to 6005 dbar

seafloor.definition: mean of each climatology column's lowest 150 dbar: the deepest level with data and the levels less than 150 dbar above it (15 levels at 10 dbar)
seafloor.after: Schmidtko et al. (2014), Science 346, 1227-1231, doi:10.1126/science.1256117; Zhou et al. (2026), Sect. 4.2
seafloor.bathymetry: the climatology's own seafloor (RTopo-2.0.4), not the explorer's

support.definition: share of the seafloor levels whose modified standard error in the full climatology is below 1e9: it writes 1e10 where no profile lies inside the mapping ellipse, and fills the value from profiles further along the isobaths
support.post2000: the post-2000 climatology's error is finite everywhere and marks no such levels, so its view is faded by the full record's support, where no profile of any year lies nearby: the least it should fade

periods.description: every profile, 1972-2023 (the OCEAN ICE full climatology)
the profiles since 2000 (the OCEAN ICE post-2000 climatology), when Argo floats and instrumented seals took over the sampling

period_difference.note: post-2000 minus full record, seafloor Conservative Temperature over the domain; the two products differ by their sampling as much as by any change, so the explorer offers no difference map

resampling.method: each cell centre is projected from EPSG:3031 to latitude and longitude (WGS84) and takes the bilinear mean of the climatology columns among its four neighbours, weights renormalised over the columns with data
resampling.reason: one package on the 10 km BedMachine grid serves every Antarctic terrain: the explorer samples it bilinearly at each terrain's own cells
resampling.cavities: only cells a lookup from some terrain's open ocean (mask class 0) can read are kept; ice-shelf cavities are left out because no profile was taken in them

domain.order: row-major order of the non-zero cells of domain_mask
domain.definition: cells that a bilinear lookup from the open ocean of any Antarctic terrain can read (the four cells around each ocean node and one ring more) and whose full-record seafloor water is defined

source_files.name: OI_Climatology.nc
source_files.description: OCEAN:ICE D1.1 - Southern Ocean Climatology (annual mean) v2

source_files.name: OI_2000_Climatology.nc
source_files.description: OCEAN:ICE D1.1 - Southern Ocean Climatology (annual mean post-2000) v2

fields.name: ct_full
fields.note: Conservative Temperature of the seafloor water (mean of the column's lowest 150 dbar), every profile 1972-2023, one value per domain cell

fields.name: sa_full
fields.note: Absolute Salinity of the seafloor water, every profile 1972-2023, one value per domain cell

fields.name: ct_post2000
fields.note: as ct_full, from the profiles since 2000; fill where that climatology has no column

fields.name: sa_post2000
fields.note: as sa_full, from the profiles since 2000; fill where that climatology has no column

fields.name: bottom_pressure
fields.note: pressure of the climatology's deepest level with data (its own RTopo-2.0.4 seafloor), full record

fields.name: support
fields.note: percent of the seafloor levels with a profile of any year inside the mapping ellipse (full record's modified standard error below 1e9); the explorer fades cells below 50 in both periods

flags.0: outside the domain (no seafloor water, or out of reach of every terrain's open ocean)
